title: See and Validate Your Full External Attack Surface with Picus and CyCognito
content_md: The assets an organization knows about and the assets an attacker can actually reach are rarely the same thing. Internet-facing systems accumulate quietly over time, and forgotten staging environments, deprecated applications, and legacy subdomains remain exposed long after anyone is watching.
